<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Configurador de Caminhão — Protótipo</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,system-ui,Arial;background:#eef0f3;color:#20242a}
.app{max-width:1400px;margin:auto;min-height:100vh;padding:24px}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{margin:0;font-size:28px} .sub{color:#68707b;font-size:14px;margin-top:4px}
.workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 350px;gap:18px}
.viewer{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 5px 24px #00000012}
.stage{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1000/560;background:linear-gradient(#f8f9fa,#e7eaee);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
.stage img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none}
.legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:12px;color:#777;font-size:12px}
.panel{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 5px 24px #00000012}
.group{margin-bottom:22px}.group h3{font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#777;margin:0 0 9px}
.options{display:grid;gap:8px}.option{border:1px solid #d9dde2;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.option:hover{background:#f7f8f9}.option.active{border-color:#20242a;background:#f1f2f4;font-weight:650}
.total{border-top:1px solid #e3e5e8;padding-top:16px;margin-top:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
button{width:100%;margin-top:14px;padding:13px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#20242a;color:white;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:850px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr}.panel{order:-1}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
<header><div><h1>Configurador de Caminhão</h1><div class="sub">Protótipo — peças montadas por camadas PNG</div></div></header>
<div class="workspace">
<section class="viewer">
<div class="stage" id="stage"></div>
<div class="legend"><span id="summary">Mercedes L1113 · 4,2 m · Basculante</span><span>1:32</span></div>
</section>
<aside class="panel">
<div class="group"><h3>Cabine</h3><div class="options">
<div class="option active" data-group="cab" data-value="cab_old" data-label="L1113 antiga" data-price="80">L1113 antiga <span>R$ 80</span></div>
<div class="option" data-group="cab" data-value="cab_black" data-label="L1113 cara preta" data-price="85">L1113 cara preta <span>R$ 85</span></div>
</div></div>
<div class="group"><h3>Chassi</h3><div class="options">
<div class="option" data-group="chassis" data-value="chassis_short" data-label="3,6 m" data-price="35">3,6 m <span>R$ 35</span></div>
<div class="option active" data-group="chassis" data-value="chassis_long" data-label="4,2 m" data-price="45">4,2 m <span>R$ 45</span></div>
</div></div>
<div class="group"><h3>Implemento</h3><div class="options">
<div class="option active" data-group="body" data-value="dump" data-label="Basculante" data-price="55">Basculante <span>R$ 55</span></div>
<div class="option" data-group="body" data-value="tank" data-label="Tanque" data-price="65">Tanque <span>R$ 65</span></div>
</div></div>
<div class="total"><span>Total</span><span id="total">R$ 180</span></div>
<button onclick="alert('Aqui você poderia gerar uma ficha da configuração ou abrir o WhatsApp.')">Solicitar orçamento</button>
</aside>
</div>
</div>
<script>
const assets = {'base': 'data:image/png;base64,', 'cab_black': 'data:image/png;base64,', 'chassis_short': 'data:image/png;base64,', 'tank': 'data:image/png;base64,', 'dump': 'data:image/png;base64,', 'chassis_long': 'data:image/png;base64,', 'cab_old': 'data:image/png;base64,'};
const stage=document.getElementById('stage');
const state={cab:'cab_old',chassis:'chassis_long',body:'dump'};
const prices={cab:80,chassis:45,body:55};
const labels={cab:'L1113 antiga',chassis:'4,2 m',body:'Basculante'};
function render(){
  stage.innerHTML='';
  ['base','chassis','cab','body'].forEach(group=>{
    const key=group==='base'?'base':state[group];
    if(assets[key]){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=assets[key];stage.appendChild(img)}
  });
  document.getElementById('total').textContent='R$ '+Object.values(prices).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  document.getElementById('summary').textContent='Mercedes L1113 · '+labels.chassis+' · '+labels.body;
}
document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const g=el.dataset.group; state[g]=el.dataset.value; prices[g]=Number(el.dataset.price); labels[g]=el.dataset.label;
  document.querySelectorAll('.option[data-group="'+g+'"]').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active')); el.classList.add('active'); render();
}));
render();
</script>
</body></html>
